Resolves #21746

Moves the ThemeSwitcher menu’s two checkmark rules from `resources/css/src/button/ThemeSwitcher.css` into `resources/css/src/menu/ThemeSwitcher.css`, preserving both selectors and every declaration. The button’s glyph, focus and responsive-label rules remain intact. The rebuilt theme map now associates the menu stylesheet with `Neo.menu.ThemeSwitcher`.

Evidence: L3 (live Brave checks of rendered checkmarks and the phone toolbar) → L3 required.
